cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_FORCED TRUE)
set(HAVE_FLAG_SEARCH_PATHS_FIRST FALSE)

project(tx_ble LANGUAGES ASM C)

SET(APPLE FALSE)


set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE ON)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE ON)

set(ProjDirPath ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.)

function(include_sources RESULT_VAR RELATIVE_PATH)
    file(GLOB_RECURSE SOURCES
        RELATIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${RELATIVE_PATH}/*.c" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${RELATIVE_PATH}/*.S"
    )
    set(${RESULT_VAR} ${${RESULT_VAR}} ${SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()


include_sources(proj_build_SOURCES "boot")
include_sources(proj_build_SOURCES "common")
include_sources(proj_build_SOURCES "platform")
include_sources(proj_build_SOURCES "system")
include_sources(proj_build_SOURCES "tx_ble")
# include_sources(proj_build_SOURCES "build")

file(GLOB_RECURSE remove_cmake "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/*")
list(REMOVE_ITEM proj_build_SOURCES ${remove_cmake})

add_executable(proj_build ${proj_build_SOURCES} )

set_target_properties(proj_build PROPERTIES SUFFIX "")

# assemble_opts_define

# assemble_opts_include
set(ASM_INCLUDE_OPTS -I${ProjDirPath}/platform/telink/TLSR9528/drivers -I${ProjDirPath}/platform/telink/common -I${ProjDirPath}/./)
target_compile_options(proj_build PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:ASM>: ${ASM_INCLUDE_OPTS}>)

# assemble_opts_contents
set(ASM_OPTS -mcmodel=medium -fmessage-length=0 -fsigned-char -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -O2 -x assembler-with-cpp -mcpu=d25f -mext-dsp -fomit-frame-pointer -fno-strict-aliasing -std=c99 -fno-jump-tables -fno-fat-lto-objects -fuse-ld=bfd)
target_compile_options(proj_build PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:ASM>: ${ASM_OPTS}>)


# c_opts_define

# c_opts_include
set(C_INCLUDE_OPTS -I${ProjDirPath}/platform/telink/TLSR9528/drivers -I${ProjDirPath}/./ -I${ProjDirPath}/platform/telink/common)
target_compile_options(proj_build PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>: ${C_INCLUDE_OPTS}>)

# c_opts_contents
set(C_OPTS -mcmodel=medium -fmessage-length=0 -fsigned-char -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -O2 -mcpu=d25f -mext-dsp -fomit-frame-pointer -fno-strict-aliasing -std=c99 -fno-jump-tables -fno-fat-lto-objects -fuse-ld=bfd)
target_compile_options(proj_build PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>: ${C_OPTS}>)

target_link_directories(proj_build PRIVATE )
target_link_options(proj_build PRIVATE -mcmodel=medium -fmessage-length=0 -fsigned-char -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -O2 -Xlinker --gc-sections -T${ProjDirPath}/boot/flash_boot.link -mcpu=d25f -mext-dsp -fomit-frame-pointer -fno-strict-aliasing -std=c99 -fno-jump-tables -fno-fat-lto-objects -fuse-ld=bfd -Wl,-Map,proj_build.map)

target_link_libraries(proj_build PRIVATE )


# prebuild postbuild

# add_custom_command(TARGET proj_build POST_BUILD COMMAND riscv32-elf-gcc -v)

# The following is the default generated postbuild, which can be annotated if not needed
add_custom_command(TARGET proj_build POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary  $<TARGET_FILE:proj_build> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:proj_build>/proj_build.bin)

add_custom_command(TARGET proj_build POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJDUMP} --source --all-headers --demangle --line-numbers --wide  $<TARGET_FILE:proj_build> > $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:proj_build>/proj_build.lst)

add_custom_command(TARGET proj_build POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_PRINTSIZE}  $<TARGET_FILE:proj_build>)
